description: Schools in flood-prone area 2013 (information 2012&2014) is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This dataset is created by clipping between Cambodia flood-prone areas in 2013 dataset and Basic information of school dataset to identify schools are under the flood extend in 2013. The basic information of school contains the spatial location of school, the attribute information in 2014, and total enrollment in 2012. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Access to education, Education and training, Pre school, Primary and secondary education. It offers 8 resource(s) in csv, geojson, jpeg, kml, shp. The portal shows 2019-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
